value.rationale: The cubic graph is the first odd monomial after the quadratic parabola and has a structurally exceptional zero-sum fiber. The exact extension norm for an infinite prime-power family and full nonuniform optimizer torus are natural analytic invariants; constant functions lose by (q-1)/(q^2(2q+1)) at every field size. The nonuniform 3:2 amplitude law is a meaningful boundary to the constant-maximizer behavior in the motivating finite-field sharp restriction literature.
